summary: SiteDocument defines a data structure for storing information about documents associated with a site. It contains fields for ID and SiteID, indicating the document's unique identifier and the site it belongs to.
purpose: To represent and manage documents that are linked to specific sites within the system.

fields.name: SiteID
fields.description: Identifier for the site to which the document is attached

summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin is a page and control set for displaying staff administrative welcome information, last login details, and managing employment application views. It features error and warning panels, validation, filtering by site and discipline, date-range selection, and grid display of applications.
purpose: To provide staff admins with a dashboard for reviewing employment applications, filtering results, and viewing administrative messages and status updates.

workflows.name: Employment Application Review
steps: User selects Site and Discipline filters
User sets Start and End date range for applications
Applications are displayed in a grid, with status and details
Withdrawn applications can be toggled for visibility
User can click refresh to update the view
Errors and warnings are presented in panels
User can click application links for detail

business_rules: Date range must be valid (StartDate <= EndDate)
Withdrawn applications are marked and can be shown/hidden
Last login is displayed if available
All and specific entries for Site/Discipline can be chosen

summary: ServiceCode is a class for representing service codes, with fields including ID, CodeCategoryID, ShortName, Name, SortOrder, Notes, and Alt-language fields. ServiceCodes contains functions to retrieve lists of service codes for various contexts from the database.
purpose: To support categorization and retrieval of service codes for courses, timetables, and other system features, with localization support.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the service code

fields.name: CodeCategoryID
fields.description: Category identifier for the service code

workflows.name: Service Code List Retrieval
steps: Localize step substitutes alt-language fields as needed

business_rules: Localization: Use alt-language fields if session requires
system_behavior: Fetch codes for all contexts or filtered by CourseID/TimetableID

summary: SiteProfileHistory tracks changes to a site profile, storing action date, section, user action, affected fields, agency, user details, and phone. It can present formatted summary and tooltip descriptions of user actions, and supports retrieval of history for a site.
purpose: To provide audit history for site profile updates, including who performed the change, when, and what section and fields were affected.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the history record

fields.name: ByUserID
fields.description: ID of user who performed change

workflows.name: Site Profile Audit History Retrieval
steps: System retrieves history records for SiteID and AgencyID
Present formatted history entries with user details and actions

business_rules: User action details are localized if alt-language fields are enabled
Formatted user/action info is provided for tooltips and audit display
system_behavior: Audit entries can be shown in a grid view
Tooltip details include agency, name and phone

summary: EmailPopupDocument is a data structure representing uploaded email-related documents. Documents can be searched and deleted, with details for filename, filepath, and checked status. EmailPopupDocuments class provides functions for document management.
purpose: To allow users to manage email popup documents, including upload, search, and delete operations.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.description: Path where the file is stored

fields.name: Checked
fields.description: Whether the file is checked for action

workflows.name: EmailPopupDocument Search and Delete
steps: Search for uploaded email popup documents via EmailPopupDocuments.Search
Delete document by ID via EmailPopupDocuments.Delete
Underlying file is deleted from file system

business_rules: Document deletion removes file and folder if empty
system_behavior: Handles file deletion and folder cleanup
Creates EmailPopupDocument entries for each file
exceptions: File delete and directory delete errors are caught silently
